story: Few birds capture the imagination quite like the Sri Lanka Bush Warbler (Pavo cristatus). As a member of the Phasianidae family, it has carved out a unique niche in Deciduous/open forest; dry semi-desert grasslands; scrub; agricultural land; and areas near water. Its conservation status is Least Concern (LC), a classification that drives crucial research and protection efforts. The Sri Lanka Bush Warbler's presence is a vital sign of its ecosystem's health, making its preservation a priority. This poster is a tribute to the Sri Lanka Bush Warbler, celebrating its role in the natural world and inspiring a deeper appreciation for biodiversity.
